items.title: George P. Fleming Interview, 1984-10-06
items.q: Marlon opened his jewelry later on mmm back about 30 what 39 yeah about 39 or 40 I worked in there

ctx.x: I got a job working for Zinkes Zinkes? Z-I-N-K-E-S Zinkes Zinkes it was on Washington between 12th and 13th by that time the old Smith it was Money Back Smith and Marlon opened his jewelry later on mmm back about 30 what 39 yeah about 39 or 40 I worked in there I worked there so I was shining and redoing shoes I would reswade shoes I learned a lot about shoes about how to change the color of shoes and how to spray the felt on shoes to make it raise up and how to dye them in different colors like white shoes we…
so I learned how to do that
